status: retrospective amendment fixed before JPEG-only fits
replacement: Within each real source's eleven R-T slots in original manifest order, alternate cached JPEG severity 1 (quality 70; six slots) and severity 2 (quality 50; five slots). Keep R-C and R-S, all AI rows, labels, source identities, slots and row order unchanged.
unchanged_operating_point: Select the smallest validation logit threshold with empirical validation FPR <=0.05 (no randomized ties), maximizing attainable validation TPR. Evaluate unchanged on test. Test-ROC TPR5 is separately descriptive and never used for threshold selection.

unchanged_bootstrap.unit: Unique source in the union of all five test cohorts, retaining every derivative and its membership in each split.
unchanged_bootstrap.stratification: Resample sources within collection (COCO, Open Images, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 3, Midjourney), using the same source multiplicities for every head and every split.
unchanged_bootstrap.estimator: Paired differences per split and arithmetic mean of the five split metric differences; percentiles across shared source-cluster resamples.
unchanged_bootstrap.conditioning: Fitted heads, validation-selected thresholds and cohort membership remain fixed; no training or threshold uncertainty is included. Individual split counts fluctuate when restricting union resamples. The same Midjourney holdout and overlapping sources are not treated as independent replications.

selection: A prespecified narrow JPEG augmentation baseline requested after completion of the clean-repeat comparison; no JPEG-only head or test result was inspected before this amendment.
limitation: JPEG-only has two distinct transformed vectors per real source rather than eleven diverse edits. Equal slots and class weighting do not equalize augmentation information or diversity; this cannot isolate the unique benefit of exact transformation matching.
